arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Corporate bond yields
yields = [2.68, 2.65, 2.58]
benchmark = 2.60

# Absolute differences
abs_diffs = [abs(y - benchmark) for y in yields]
print('Absolute differences:', abs_diffs)

# Average deviation
avg_deviation = sum(abs_diffs) / len(abs_diffs)
print('Average deviation:', avg_deviation)
print('Rounded to 2 decimals:', round(avg_deviation, 2))
"
